description: This file defines classes, macros, and functions related to warning reporting control within a software system. It includes mechanisms for categorizing warnings, serializing/deserializing warning data, and managing warning categories and exclusions. The file also provides macros for reporting warnings and out-of-bounds conditions, and manages warning categories with configurable bounds and behaviors.

classes.name: WarningReportingBoundsCategory
classes.description: Manages warning bounds and analysis for a specific warning category, including serialization, deserialization, and configuration.

classes.name: WarningReportingType
classes.description: Template class representing a warning reporting category, including analysis, serialization, and control functionalities.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy
classes.description: Singleton class that manages warning reporting categories, including reporting events, fetching category info, and managing category list.

classes.name: ExcludedWarnings
classes.description: Manages lists of callsigns and modules excluded from warning reporting.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures warning bounds and specific settings for a category.

methods.name: CategoryName
methods.description: Returns the name of the warning category.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Analyzes a warning condition based on actual value and optional parameters.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes warning data into a buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes warning data from a buffer.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts warning data to a string representation.

methods.name: IsWarning
methods.description: Determines if the current warning is a warning or an error based on bounds.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Checks if the warning category is enabled or sets its enabled state.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Releases resources and unregisters the warning category.
